source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3.1 with Figures 15.8 and 15.9, printed page 330.

blocks.text: Paper chromatography, partition chromatography ki ek qism hai. Kaghaz ke cellulose fibers (reshon) mein phansa hua pani (stationary phase) aur kaghaz par se guzarne wali mobile phase aapas mein nahi milte (immiscible hain). Mobile phase aam taur par koi organic liquid hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do dhakan wale jar. Baayen: kaghaz ki patti (stationary phase) solvent (mobile phase) mein doobi hai aur solvent ke zara oopar siyahi ka spot. Daayen: solvent, solvent front tak chadh gaya aur spot narangi, neele, sabz aur laal spots mein bat gaya; teer solvent ke behne ka rukh dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.8: Paper chromatography (kitab ki Figure 15.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Solvent capillary action se kaghaz par oopar chadhta hai aur syahi ke components ko saath le jata hai. Jo component solvent mein zyada hal hota hai woh zyada oopar jata hai (narangi), jo kaghaz ke pani se zyada chipakta hai woh neeche rehta hai (laal).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer ke label mein 'stationery phase' chhapa hai; sahi 'stationary phase' (thehri hui phase) hai. Caption ka 'chromatagraphy' bhi 'chromatography' hona chahiye.

Paper chromatography teen aam tareeqon se ki jati hai: (i) ascending (oopar chadhne wala) (ii) descending (neeche utarne wala) (iii) radial / circular (gol). Yahan sirf ascending tareeqa bayan hai. Is mein solvent capillary action (bareek raston mein khud oopar chadhna) se oopar ki taraf chalta hai.

Sample ke mutabiq khaas tor par banaya gaya solvent mixture chromatographic tank mein dalein. Tank ko dhak dein taake andar ki fiza (atmosphere) har jagah ek jaisi ho jaye (solvent ki bhaap se bhar jaye). Whatman chromatographic paper No.1 ki taqreeban 20 cm lambi patti (strip) lein aur ek sire se taqreeban 2.5 cm par pencil se patli lakeer khenchein. Is lakeer par sample mixture solution ka ek spot lagayen. Components pehchanne mein aasani ke liye saath saath maloom (known) compounds ke spots bhi lagaye ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan chromatographic tank ke liye 'Figure 15.7' likhti hai, lekin Figure 15.7 fractional distillation ka set-up hai. Tank Figure 15.8 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Do band jar. Ascending tareeqa: kaghaz neeche pani ki pyali mein khara hai, spot pani ke zara oopar. Descending tareeqa: kaghaz oopar pani ki trough se latka hai, spot trough ke zara neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.9: Ascending aur descending paper chromatography (kitab ki Figure 15.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ascending mein solvent neeche se oopar chadhta hai; descending mein oopar ki trough se neeche utarta hai (gravity bhi madad karti hai). Dono mein spot solvent ke qareeb lagaya jata hai magar solvent mein duboya nahi jata.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein 'spol of indicator' chhapa hai; sahi 'spot of indicator' hai. Caption ka 'chromotography' bhi 'chromatography' hona chahiye.

Jab spots sookh jayen to kaghaz ko clips se is tarah latkayen ke spot wala sira solvent mixture mein 5-6 mm tak doobe. Tank dhak dein. Jab solvent front (solvent ki oopar wali hadd) spots se guzarta hai to solutes oopar chalne lagte hain. Solute ke mukhtalif components mukhtalif raftar se chalte hain, aur yun mixture alag ho jata hai. Jab solvent front kaghaz ki zyada tar lambai tak chadh jaye to patti nikal lein, solvent front par pencil se nishan lagayen aur patti ko sookhne dein.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'about length of the paper' ke darmiyan ek number (kaghaz ki lambai ka hissa) chhapne se reh gaya hai. Matlab yeh hai ke solvent front ko kaghaz ke oopar wale sire tak pohnchne se kuch pehle rok dein, taake front ka nishan lagaya ja sake.

items: Paper chromatography (partition): stationary phase = cellulose mein phansa pani, mobile phase = organic liquid; ascending, descending ya radial.
Ascending: dhaka tank, Whatman No.1 patti, 2.5 cm par pencil lakeer, sample aur known compounds ke spots, 5-6 mm dubana, components mukhtalif raftar se chadhte hain, front ka nishan, sukhana.
